items.title: Super Micro Computer (SMCI) Unveils H15 Servers As Export Scrutiny Draws Focus
items.summary: Super Micro Computer (NasdaqGS:SMCI) launched its new H15 server portfolio built around 6th Gen AMD EPYC processors for AI and cloud workloads. The H15 line is designed to support higher core density and next generation GPUs aimed at advanced AI inference and training use cases. Regulators are scrutinizing reports that Super Micro servers with Nvidia chips were rented to China's Moonshot AI despite export control concerns. items.title: Exclusive-Military-linked Chinese university bought Nvidia H200 chips despite US blacklist, records show
